Introduction

Cheeze, also known as Dalchong is a South Korean singer under Magic Strawberry Sound. She is a member of the project group CSVC.

She was a member of Cheeze. After all the members except her left the group, she decided to use the group’s name as her stage name.

She released her first solo single on February 20, 2017.
